_comment: Token prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by model id.
Provider pricing changes and varies by tier, so a model is priced here only
with a rate copied from the provider's official pricing page, with that page
in 'source' and the date it was checked in 'verifiedOn'. A stale constant
would silently produce wrong cost figures in BENCHMARK.md: re-check the page
and update 'verifiedOn' before publishing new numbers.
gemini-3.1-flash-lite: Standard (paid) tier, text input, from
checked 2026-10-22). 'cachedInput' is the context-caching price charged for
prompt tokens served from cache; output includes thinking tokens, which is
how agent/providers/gemini.js already counts output. Cache storage fees apply
only to explicit caches, which the agent does not create. The free tier
charges nothing for the same runs; these figures are what the paid tier bills.
Until a model is priced here, the agent reports token counts (which are
measured and real) and reports cost as null with reason 'unpriced'.
It never estimates a dollar figure it cannot substantiate.
